indicator("QP RES-1000 · Prev Day", overlay = true, max_lines_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500, max_boxes_count = 500, max_bars_back = 500)

// ---------- STARTER ----------
st1_on  = input.bool(true,     "Show previous day H/L/C",       group = "Starter · Previous day")
st1_cHi = input.color(#ffd700, "PD High",  inline = "st1", group = "Starter · Previous day")
st1_cLo = input.color(#ffd700, "PD Low",   inline = "st1", group = "Starter · Previous day")
st1_cCl = input.color(#ffffff, "PD Close", inline = "st1", group = "Starter · Previous day")

[st1_h, st1_l, st1_c] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", [high[1], low[1], close[1]], lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)

plot(st1_on ? st1_h : na, "PD High",  color = st1_cHi, style = plot.style_stepline, linewidth = 1)
plot(st1_on ? st1_l : na, "PD Low",   color = st1_cLo, style = plot.style_stepline, linewidth = 1)
plot(st1_on ? st1_c : na, "PD Close", color = st1_cCl, style = plot.style_stepline, linewidth = 1)
